details.summary: An excellent, highly practical recipe that brilliantly uses a ready-to-eat quinoa pouch to meet the 30-minute promise. With one minor tweak to the preheat instruction, this is ready to print.

dimensions.feedback: The savory umami from the beef and portobellos is beautifully balanced by the acidity of the tomatoes and the briny, salty punch of the feta.
Every listed ingredient is used properly in the instructions, and the division of the olive oil is clearly tracked.

The preheat instruction does not state its expected duration, and Step 1 implies putting the mushrooms in immediately rather than waiting for the oven to get hot. Fix: Update Step 1 to say, 'Preheat the oven to 400°F / 200°C (this takes 10 to 15 minutes). Once hot, place the mushroom caps...'
Perfectly fits the Mediterranean-American style, leaning heavily on olive oil, garlic, oregano, and feta.
Roasting the portobello caps extracts excess water and concentrates their flavor, while a hot skillet ensures the lean beef browns without steaming.
The computed macros perfectly align with the ingredient list; the 4.4g saturated fat is completely accurate for 96% lean ground beef combined with a measured amount of feta and olive oil.
The title and intro are warm, accurate, and appetizing, with no banned language or unproven health claims.
An elegant, visually appealing weeknight meal that transforms everyday ground beef into a beautiful centerpiece.

Genuinely answers both conditions: uses extra-lean beef (protecting the liver from excess saturated fat) and pairs it with massive vegetable volume and a high-quality intact grain to stabilize blood sugar.
Zero added sugar, and the quinoa pouch delivers a fantastic, high-quality complex carbohydrate that lands perfectly inside the 32-55g window.
Hits the 'Lean Meat Dinners' brief precisely. It provides a measured portion of beef and stays well under the 5g saturated fat ceiling.

Fully achievable in under 30 minutes from a cold start, including the oven preheat, thanks to the smart parallel cooking of the skillet filling and the use of the ready-to-eat quinoa pouch (a first-class shortcut).
